author: kycrafft
body:
Skywars map but there are monuments on top of some of the houses. These houses are marked with wool flags. You have the same spawn kit as barbarian but with a pickaxe. You have to break a monument to capture it. Others can capture one of your captured monuments by breaking it. You need to capture all the monuments to win. Nerf the OP chest items too. 

Blue vs. Green vs. Red on the original skywars map (with enderb@77z duh)


Wow. The sentence structure is not repetitive at all...
